snippet.title: PlayStation - Honoo no Ryourinin - Cooking Fighter Hao (1998)

DESCRIPTION
Honoo no Ryourinin: Cooking Fighter Hao is an Action game, published by Nippon Ichi Software, which was released in Japan in 1998.
